summary: Coordinate station-area land use, transport and delivery priorities. Explore the course and strengthen your TOD planning practice.
lede: Transit-oriented development planning helps urban and transport planners coordinate land use, station access and infrastructure investment around public transport. Designed for planners, infrastructure programme managers and public-sector development specialists, the course supports preparation of station-area plans. You will map station catchments, build land-use and transport coordination matrices, and develop phased investment roadmaps with monitoring indicators.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for linking public-transport investment with the planning, development and management of nearby land. It is designed for practitioners who need to translate corridor or station plans into coordinated public-sector actions.
prerequisites: Recommended: basic familiarity with urban planning, transport planning or public infrastructure project delivery. No coding is required.
